Assistant (0.3s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Ms Nair?

User (1.5s): Yes, this is Priya Nair.

Assistant (2.1s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (3.7s): Why do you need that?

Assistant (4.7s): These questions protect your account, and I can tell you more once your identity is confirmed. Please go ahead.

User (6.5s): Seventeenth of May nineteen eighty six.

Assistant (8.0s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (9.7s): One five zero two.

Assistant (11.1s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. Your credit card ending 1903 has a past-due amount of 2125.10, which is 12 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (11.7s): Which account is this about?

Assistant (12.9s): This is about your credit card ending 1903. Can you make the payment today?

User (15.2s): The full amount is too much right now.

Assistant (16.7s): For your credit card ending 1903, can you pay 637.50 on Wednesday 14 October 2026? The rest stays overdue. Can you make that payment?

User (19.5s): That is still too much for me

Assistant (20.6s): The amount I just proposed is the lowest I can record. Can you pay it on Wednesday 14 October 2026?

User (23.4s): You tell me.

Assistant (24.5s): I am asking if you can make the payment. Can you make the payment I proposed on Wednesday 14 October 2026?

User (27.1s): I can do the minimum payment this Friday.

Assistant (28.5s): To confirm: you will pay 637.50 for the credit card ending 1903 on Friday 16 October 2026. Do you confirm?

User (29.9s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (30.9s): Thank you, one moment please.

Assistant (31.7s): Thank you. Your promise of 637.50 for the credit card ending 1903 on Friday 16 October 2026 is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
